cohort: The study included 122 patients (61% female) with myelomeningocele who were followed longitudinally at a single center from 1975 to 2013.
finding: Falx dysgenesis, lumbar myelomeningocele, and cortical atrophy were significantly associated with epileptic seizure development, but myelomeningocele patients with seizures generally have a good prognosis with considerable long-term seizure freedom.
